xyz=np.array(mol.GetConformer().GetPositions());ncoords=xyz[[atom[n] for n in ['a','b','c','d']]]; print('four N locations',ncoords,'distances from mean',np.linalg.norm(ncoords-ncoords.mean(axis=0),axis=1))
Mg=ncoords.mean(axis=0)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:

 for at,p in zip(mol.GetAtoms(),xyz): f.write(f'{at.GetSymbol()} {p[0]:.8f} {p[1]:.8f} {p[2]:.8f}\n')
